entry.title: Profit-5 2.0.0
entry.summary: # Profit-5 2.0.0 Profit-5 2.0.0 adds a native MPC screen, Q-Links on every page and named favourites. The sound engine is unchanged. ## What's new - Native MPC screen: the Oscillators, Filter Amp and Programmer pages with live knobs, switches and LEDs. The mixer now sits next to the oscillators; Glide and Unison moved to the filter page. - Q-Links on every page: six sub-tabs in groups of four that follow the panel rows. - Favourites: `+FAV` names the current sound on an on-screen keyboard and st

entry.title: Profit-5 0.2.1
entry.summary: Five-voice analog polysynth modelled on an early SSM-chip Prophet-5: Rev 2 / Rev 4 voicing, 38 factory programs, and it imports Repro-5 .h2p patches. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. entry.title: Profit-5 0.1.1
entry.summary: 0.1.1: built with the wrapper fixes from mpc-vst-plugins #486-#489 (Q-Links on the automation screen, display-update limits, params.lock). Tested on a Force 2026-10-22 (device): loads, plays, all pages, Q-Links, save and reload. CPU about 28% of a core at five voices (WARN). Gen2 zip untested.

entry.title: Profit-5 0.1.0
entry.summary: Test build 0.1.0. Install on a Force or MPC Gen1 with root access (see INSTALL.md in the zip). Checked on a Force 2026-10-21 (device): loads, plays, skin and Q-Links work. CPU: about 28% of a core at five voices (WARN). Gen2 zip is untested.
